data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this spacious 1-bedroom apartment in X1 Tower, Jumeirah Bay, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) — a vibrant waterfront community known for its excellent connectivity and lifestyle amenities.

Property Details:

• 1 Bedroom
• 2 Bathrooms
• Size: 971.77 sq.ft
• Unfurnished
• Lake View
• Spacious Layout
• 1 Allocated Parking Space

The apartment features a well-designed layout with a bright living and dining area, large windows that allow plenty of natural light, and a comfortable bedroom with built-in wardrobes. The additional bathroom adds convenience for guests. With its generous size and lake views, this property offers both comfort and practicality for end-users and investors.

Building Amenities:

• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Games Room
• 24/7 Security and CCTV
• Covered Parking
• High-Speed Elevators

X1 Tower is located in the Jumeirah Bay cluster of JLT, offering easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Marina, and major business districts. Residents enjoy nearby restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, and walking paths around the lakes, making it an ideal location for both living and investment.
